title: Prize Escrow
summary: Hold a competition prize on chain and pay winners from a challengeable merkle payout root.
what: Prize Escrow is make.fun's Anchor 1.2.1 program for competition prizes. Sponsors lock the prize up front, a bonded resolver posts the result as a merkle root, a challenge window lets anyone dispute it, and winners pull their share with merkle proofs.
app_note: The page at /dapps/prize-escrow/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/prize-escrow.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/prize-escrow/, switch to Devnet, and connect a wallet. The lab already ran a full competition.
try_steps.see: Escrow CC8eHLKx… is Claimable with its vault fully claimed.

diagram: admin --initialize_config--> config; sponsor --open_escrow--> escrow + vault; resolver --commit_entries/post_result(+bond)--> Challengeable; (challenge window) --settle--> Claimable; winner --claim(proof)--> payout + receipt.
accounts: vault ATA owned by the escrow
innovation: The prize is locked before the competition and the result is a bonded, challengeable commitment, so winners do not depend on the sponsor paying later.
exercises: Why is the leaf hashed twice with a 0 prefix?
What stops a winner claiming twice?
